security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src blob:; frame-src blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Vibe code from one app: worktrees, live diffs, a file explorer and a terminal.
bundle.longDescription: GitViber shows full-file diffs that update live as agents write, every worktree one click away, and a terminal right under the diff. It runs the git CLI with your own config, hooks, credentials and signing.
